view: PA (frontal), L marker over patient's left shoulder confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate inspiration, mild rotation, acceptable penetration; both costophrenic angles included; lungs, hila and mediastinum well displayed. Bony thorax and left supraclavicular region partly overlapped by external label/marker.

devices.location: upper right corner of image, projected over patient's left shoulder/clavicle

devices.type: cluster of small linear metallic densities, probable surgical clips (post lymph node biopsy) - external artifact not fully excluded
devices.location: patient's left supraclavicular region, just above the left clavicle

devices.type: rectangular film label / identifier marker with ring emblem (external)
devices.location: upper right corner of image, patient's left shoulder

abnormalities.finding: Well-defined oval pulmonary mass abutting the lateral chest wall, approx 3.5-4.5 cm (largest lesion)
Well-defined round pulmonary mass lateral to the hilum, approx 3 cm
Additional smaller pulmonary nodules (approx 1 cm) - right mid zone and perihilar/lower zone on the left; picture of multiple bilateral masses/nodules (metastases to be excluded in this age group)
Bilateral lobulated hilar enlargement with widened mediastinal contour, suspicious for hilar and mediastinal lymphadenopathy
No pleural effusion or pneumothorax; costophrenic angles sharp; no chest tube

description_zh: 正面胸部X光片，患者左側可見 L 標記，方向為傳統擺位。雙側肺野可見多發性邊界清楚的圓形／橢圓形腫塊：右下肺野外側貼近胸壁處最大一顆約 4 公分，左中肺野肺門外側另一顆約 3 公分，另於右中肺野及左肺門周圍可見數個約 1 公分的較小結節。雙側肺門增大且呈分葉狀，縱膈腔輪廓亦增寬，疑合併肺門與縱膈淋巴結腫大。左鎖骨上區可見成簇的細小金屬密度影，疑為手術夾（淋巴結切片術後）；未見胸管或引流管，無明顯肋膜積液或氣胸。
